shortDescription: UPSC EPFO / APFC Online Form 2026 is open under Special Advt. No. 52/2026. The last date to apply online is 11 September 2026, and candidates should submit before the portal closes.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has published the recruitment notice for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) under Special Advertisement No. 52/2026.

The online application window is open from 22/08/2026 to 11/09/2026. This is the last date to submit the UPSC EPFO APFC 2026 online form, so candidates are advised to complete the application today and check all uploaded details carefully before payment and final submission.

Application checklist

  • Register on the official UPSC online application portal.
  • Complete OTR, if not already done.
  • Fill the APFC form, upload photograph, signature and required documents.
  • Pay the applicable fee and verify every field on the preview screen.
  • Save the registration number, payment receipt and final application PDF.

The written examination is scheduled for 20/12/2026. Admit card and further selection updates should be checked on the official UPSC website.
